heading: Understand your rights (Welsh version)
section.heading: Requesting a court hearing transcript
section.intro1: You can apply for a transcript of a court or tribunal hearing if the hearing was recorded.
section.intro2: The court can refuse to provide part or all of a transcript (for example, if details of the hearing are confidential).
section.intro3: There are different ways to apply depending on which part of the transcript you want and whether you are eligible for a free copy.
section.intro4: Hearings at magistrates' courts are never recorded.
sentencing.heading: Get a transcript of the sentencing remarks only
sentencing.para1: If someone pleads guilty or is found guilty in a Crown Court, then the judge will decide what punishment they get. The judge will make sentencing remarks to explain their decision.
sentencing.para2.before: You might be able to find a transcript of the judgment or sentencing remarks for free online
sentencing.para2.link2Text: on the Courts and Tribunals Judiciary website
sentencing.para3: You can also apply for a transcript of the sentencing remarks for free if you're involved in a case because you're either:
sentencing.eligibleItems: a family member of a victim of murder, manslaughter or an offence that caused death on the road
a victim of rape or sexual offences, or you're applying on their behalf
sentencing.applyOnlineLinkText: use the online service to apply
sentencing.applyFormLinkText: download and fill in the paper form to apply
sentencing.para4: The court will decide whether you can get a free transcript after you apply. You'll get a response within 20 working days of applying.
sentencing.para5: If you're not eligible for a free transcript of the sentencing remarks, you can apply for a transcript of all or part of the hearing.
fullHearing.heading: Get a transcript of all or part of the hearing
fullHearing.para1.after: and read the accompanying guidance notes.
fullHearing.para2: The guidance notes will explain the final fee, which will vary depending on the transcript's size, whether it's a new transcript or a copy, and other factors.
fullHearing.para3: Return the form by email or post to:
fullHearing.returnItem2: the contact details in section 2d of the guidance notes, if you  want a transcript of a judgment from the Court of Appeal Criminal  Division or the Administrative Court
fullHearing.para4: You can choose how soon you would like the transcript to arrive from the options on the form.
